zh.title: 美祭無人機關稅東元評估在美生產為升無直接影響
zh.summary: 美祭無人機關稅；東元評估在美生產；為升稱無直接影響
body: 美國總統川普於8月13日宣布，將對進口無人機及其零組件徵收最高達100%關稅，對歐盟、日本、韓國及台灣等盟友產品課徵15%關稅。
東元表示，其無人機動力系統以商用和農用為主，未來將評估在美國在地化生產的可能性。
為升電裝指出，從目前公開訊息看，反無人機設備不在本次關稅課徵範圍內，因此對其業務無直接影響。
怡利電子則說明，其無人機引擎精密組件主要應用於歐洲商用無人機產品，出貨以非北美市場為主，關稅政策對其亦無影響。

en.title: US Imposes Drone Tariffs; Taiwan’s Tung Yuan Evaluates US Production, Ascent Sees No Direct Impact
en.summary: US drone tariffs; Tung Yuan evaluates US output; Ascent sees no impact
body: On August 13, 2026, US President Donald Trump announced tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and components, with a 15% rate on allies including the EU, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan.
Tung Yuan said its drone power systems are mainly for commercial and agricultural use and that it will assess the possibility of local production in the United States.
Ascent Electric stated that its drone counter‑measure systems fall outside the scope of the new tariffs and therefore will not be directly affected.

Yili Electronic noted that its drone engine precision parts are primarily supplied to European commercial drone customers, with shipments mainly to non‑North American markets, so the tariff policy has no impact on it.
